description: Search Washington State hiking trails from wta.org by region, keyword, or get detailed trail info.

fetchDetails.description: When enabled, fetches the detail page for each trail to get lat/lon, full description, and rating. Slower but more complete.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch detailed trail info

maxLengthMiles.description: Filter: only include trails <= this length in miles.
maxLengthMiles.title: Max trail length (miles)

minLengthMiles.description: Filter: only include trails >= this length in miles.
minLengthMiles.title: Min trail length (miles)

minRating.description: Filter: only include trails with average rating >= this value (0–5).
minRating.title: Min rating

enumTitles: Get detailed trail info by URL
mode.title: Mode

region.description: Washington State region to filter trails. Examples: Snoqualmie Region, North Cascades, Olympics, Mount Rainier Area, Puget Sound and Islands.
region.title: Region

regionFilter.description: Additional free-text filter on region field (e.g. Snoqualmie Pass).
regionFilter.title: Region text filter

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword search for trail names or features.
searchQuery.title: Search query

trailUrls.description: List of WTA trail page URLs to fetch details for.
trailUrls.title: Trail URLs (mode=getTrailDetails)

title: WTA Washington Trails Scraper Input
